why_visit: Unique geological formation showing seven distinct colors of sand formed by volcanic activity
visitor_info: Open daily 8:30 AM - 5:30 PM. Entrance Rs 250 adults
tips: Combine with Chamarel Waterfall. No touching the sand.

why_visit: Historic garden founded 1770. Famous for giant water lilies, spice plants, and 80+ palm species
visitor_info: Open daily 8:30 AM - 5:30 PM. Entry Rs 200
tips: Hire a guide for detailed plant information. Allow 2-3 hours.

why_visit: UNESCO World Heritage Site. Symbol of slave resistance. Stunning views from summit.
visitor_info: Guided hikes available. Moderate to hard difficulty
tips: Bring 2L water per person. Good hiking shoes essential.

why_visit: Largest national park protecting rare endemic species. 60km of hiking trails through native forest.
visitor_info: Free entry. Visitor center open 9 AM - 4 PM
tips: Bring binoculars for bird watching. Check weather before hiking.

why_visit: Sacred Hindu lake and pilgrimage site. Largest Shiva statue outside India. Peaceful spiritual atmosphere.
visitor_info: Open daily. Free entry. Dress modestly
tips: Remove shoes before entering temples. Photography allowed.

why_visit: Adventure park with safari, zip-lining, quad biking. Walk with lions experience. 4500 birds.
visitor_info: Open 9 AM - 6 PM daily. Tickets from Rs 850
tips: Book activities in advance. Full day needed for all attractions.

why_visit: Vibrant local market selling crafts, spices, fresh produce. Authentic Mauritian experience.
visitor_info: Open Mon-Sat 5 AM - 6 PM. Sunday 5 AM - noon
tips: Bargaining expected. Try local street food. Watch for pickpockets.

why_visit: UNESCO site. Immigration depot where indentured laborers arrived 1849-1923. Important heritage site.
visitor_info: Open Mon-Fri 9 AM - 4 PM. Free entry
tips: Take guided tour for full historical context. 30-45 min visit.

why_visit: Colonial mansion built 1830s. Museum showcasing Creole architecture. Beautiful gardens with waterfall.
visitor_info: Open daily 9 AM - 5 PM. Entry Rs 350
tips: Lunch available in traditional Creole style. Garden walk takes 30 mins.

why_visit: Crocodile and tortoise park. Over 2000 Nile crocodiles. Giant Aldabra tortoises. Insectarium.
visitor_info: Open daily 9:30 AM - 5 PM. Entry Rs 600
tips: Crocodile feeding at 11 AM daily. Allow 2-3 hours for full visit.

why_visit: Unique rectangular waterfall cascading over basalt rock. Swimming possible in pools below.
best_time: After heavy rain for best flow
tips: Wear water shoes. Path can be slippery. Bring swimwear.

why_visit: Optical illusions and interactive exhibits. Fun for families. Upside-down house. Mind-bending rooms.
visitor_info: Open daily 9 AM - 5 PM. Entry Rs 400
tips: Great for photos. Kids love it. 1-2 hour visit.

why_visit: Houses rare Blue Penny and Red Penny stamps. Maritime history. Art exhibitions.
visitor_info: Open Mon-Sat 10 AM - 5 PM. Entry Rs 250
tips: Air-conditioned refuge from heat. Combine with waterfront shopping.

why_visit: Restored 1856 mansion. Rum distillery tours. Orchards with tropical fruits. Fine dining restaurant.
visitor_info: Open daily 9 AM - 5 PM. Entry Rs 350
tips: Rum tasting included. Book lunch in advance. Beautiful photography.

why_visit: Naval battle artifacts from 1810 French-British clash. Housed in colonial mansion. Shipwreck relics.
visitor_info: Open Mon-Sat 9 AM - 4 PM. Free entry
tips: Combine with Mahebourg market on Monday. Waterfront walk nearby.
